name: Weight-Tracker
description: A self-hosted mobile-first weight tracking application. Log your daily weight, track water consumption, monitor activity type and sleep quality, and visualize your progress with interactive charts. Features: - Weight tracking with activity type and sleep quality - Water consumption tracking - Interactive progress charts with time filters - Multi-user support with admin and user roles - Customizable date formats and chart colors - Customizable activity

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Path to store application data (users, weight entries, settings)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions (99 = nobody on Unraid)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions (100 = users on Unraid)

variables.name: API_KEY
variables.description: Secret key for API authentication. Enables Home Assistant integration. Use X-API-User header to specify user. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
